title: A Primer of the Kukri Belly
summary: Teaches the untrained how the inward belly of the kukri falls into a target with body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Forward-Weighted Blade
summary: Shows beginners how to carry a blade that is heavy toward the tip and let its weight do the work.

title: The Brush-Clearing Workbook
summary: Gives farm hands and foot travellers the plain chops used to open a path through thick growth.

title: Kukri Grips and Wrist Turns
summary: Explains the full-hand grip of the kukri and the wrist turns that steer each chop onto its line.

title: Short Treatise on the Inward Curve
summary: Studies how the inward curve catches and drags and how a strong body can use that bite.

title: First Qi in the Curved Blade
summary: Introduces a student who has awakened qi to the first light flow of qi along a chopping blade.

title: Workbook of the Chopping Draw
summary: Drills the draw from the sheath into a chop with a thread of qi behind the first cut.

title: Handbook of Hewing and Notch Catches
summary: Teaches heavy hewing cuts and the use of the blade notch to catch and hold an opposing edge.

title: Drill-Book of the Hip-Sheath Draw
summary: Trains a quick qi-aided draw from the hip sheath and the first three cuts that follow it.

title: Canon of the Weighted Edge
summary: Sets out how a student with steady qi times each chop so the weighted edge lands with full force.
